name: flightdeck
description: Flightdeck: a minimal developer HUD for Claude Code. Model and effort controls, usage and context meters, chat history with a side-by-side diff viewer, extension calls and token estimates, and compact rows for edits and shell commands.

compactEdits.title: Compact edit rows
compactEdits.description: Hide code and diffs in the chat, for edits and shell commands alike, and show the action, repository, file and line counts instead. ctrl+o still shows the full change.

openOnStart.title: Open the panel at session start
openOnStart.description: Open the Flightdeck panel beside the chat when a session starts, if the terminal is wide enough.
